purpose: Define request/response schemas for four future MCP tools (launch_task, task_status, collect_result, cancel_task) that let Codex request task pickup and spawn model CLI commands LATER, and receive completion summaries. This artifact is a schema/contract ONLY: it adds no server wiring, no subprocess/exec/fork/shell code, and no live agent spawn. All four tools are LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED=false in this MVP.

invariant.source_of_truth: AITools/taskctl.py JSONL/SQLite (bitnnv2/data/tasking/task_queue_v1.sqlite); this contract adds no parallel store
invariant.rollback: no code path to roll back; contract defines schema only

safety_model.even_if_flag_set: no launcher code exists yet in the allowed_writes of this task, so no flag value can trigger a spawn
safety_model.preconditions_reused_from: phase2_orchestration_contract_b104_v1.launch_preconditions (allow_launch_flag, allow_writes_flag, runner_topic_allowlist, command_allowlist_match, collision_guard_preflight, dry_run_default, cwd_env_sandbox_pin, concurrency_cap, audit_log_entry, adapter_available)

aiworkhub_agent_launch_task.summary: Plan (never execute) a worker launch for a claimed task_id via one of the three adapters. MVP always runs in dryrun mode regardless of the mode field.

mode.note: MVP accepts only dryrun; a 'live' value is rejected with launch_blocked_disabled, never silently promoted

request_id.description: opaque id, generated locally, not persisted to any new store

would_run_argv.description: argv-list template only, e.g. ['claude','-p','<prompt>','--cwd','<repo>']; empty for deepseek_manual

audit_ref.description: path/tag of the append-only audit log entry recorded for this decision

aiworkhub_agent_task_status.summary: Read-only status lookup that layers on taskctl show; no separate process/job store is created.

request_id.description: optional correlation id returned by a prior launch_task call

taskctl_status.description: verbatim result of core.show_task(task_id) / taskctl show <task_id>; taskctl JSONL/SQLite remains sole source of truth

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this status read

aiworkhub_agent_collect_result.summary: Read-only completion-summary collector. In this MVP there is never a real launched process, so a genuine result is never available; verdict is always not_applicable_mvp or pending.

review_ready.description: MVP never marks a task review-ready via this tool; only taskctl review does

aiworkhub_agent_cancel_task.summary: Cancel a planned (never a running) launch. Because no process is ever started in this MVP, cancellation only ever clears a local plan record, never a real process.

response.blocked_reason: mode 'live' not supported by MVP; launch never implemented

response.summary: No process was ever launched for this task in this MVP; nothing to collect.

response.note: No process exists to cancel in this MVP; only a dry-run plan (if any) is cleared.

neural_bridge_note: Adapter/runner/topic selection for a real future launch must be a LEARNED routing + abstain decision (tracked as MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1, see bitnnv2/data/curriculum/mcp_launch_routing_targets_v1.jsonl), never a regex/keyword cue router. This schema itself is a static, human-authored safety/interface boundary (request/response shape), not a cognitive routing decision, so it does not violate the neural-control-first doctrine.
no_launch_code_marker: This artifact defines JSON schema only. No subprocess/exec/fork/shell/network code is introduced by this task. Real launch code remains gated behind CLAUDE_TASK_MCP_GATED_LAUNCH_EXECUTOR_B107_V1 and all launch_preconditions.
